Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane and reported that Driver 2 struck the side of the vehicle while Driver 1 was
compleitng a left turn at the intersection in Katy, Texas. Driver 1 stated that the impact pushed the vehicle forward
and that a sholuder injury was sustained during the collision. Driver 2 was present at the scene and was cooperative
throughout the investigation. The daamge visible on Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with the direction and force of the
impact described by both parties. Scene photographs taken at the location confirm several of the reported details,
although no independent witnesses came forward to provide a statement. The responding officers and the parties at
the scene confirm that a Passenger was also inside Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision. Inspection did not
reveal any prior damage to the vehicle, and no earlier repairs were identified. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on
the policy involved. The reported injury appears consistent with the nature and force of the impact. No citations were
issued at the scene, and the matter has been documented for further review.
